description: Everything about a domain in one call: DNS records (A, AAAA, NS, MX, TXT, CAA, CNAME), email security graded A-F (mail provider, SPF, DMARC policy, DKIM at common selectors, BIMI, with findings) and RDAP registration (registrar, created, expires, age in days, status, nameservers, DNSSEC). Repeat lookups list what changed since the previous check. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.
